ignores.reason: golang.org/x/sys windows.NewNTUnicodeString integer overflow. The fix (0.44.0) requires Go 1.25 and the pinned toolchain is 1.24.7 (ADR-025). The function is only defined, never called, by modernc.org/sqlite, modernc.org/libc or VSF code (checked with grep and a windows dependency listing); linux builds do not link the package.
